Name: Natural Accent Interface - Generic Mod Config Menu Recolor
Author: thirtythreepaces
Description:
Hello! I adore [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sinistea/about-me?gameId=1303]sinistea’s[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21865]Natural Accent Interface[/url], so I made this small recolor to make the icons from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] match. If sinistea updates their mod to accommodate GMCM I will happily delete this! 

Simply unzip these files and replace the assets of the same name within GMCM.

To install:
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed.
[*]Download and unzip this mod.
[*]Place the two .png files included in this mod (“config-button” and “keybindings-button”) into the “assets” folder within the GenericModConfigMenu mod.

[*]When your computer asks what you would like to do with the duplicate files, select “replace”.

[*]Finished!

[/list]
